_comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a recording of any site.
Reproduces the shape GET /manga/tag returns (confirmed live 2026-09-24):
the same collection envelope as every other endpoint, one entity per tag,
attributes carrying a language-keyed name and a group. The real API
answers 77 tags across four groups (genre, theme, format, content); this
fixture keeps one of each plus a second genre, which is enough to prove
Listings() keeps only group=='genre' and sorts what it keeps by name.
